result.summary: The tenant reported a loose water pipe in the back garden. We asked the landlord whether to send a contractor or whether they would arrange their own. The landlord (Grace Oakley, Director) replied "We will sort this issue", so she is arranging the repair herself. I recorded that answer, emailed the tenant to tell them, and put a 7-day hold on the ticket to check the repair gets done. The landlord doesn't need a reply, which answers the internal note in event 006.
